purpose: The data side gives parts, the web composes (owner principle 2026-10-14, root ADR-0193 §5). A Gold column, a kind line or a Gold producer that carries a screen's words, joins values into display text, pages a list to an old API's size, or names a screen is refused here. This file is the one list of those shapes; scripts/guard/data-knows-no-screen.sh reads it and its self-test plants each one.

shapes.reason: a label or display field is text a screen writes from the source's values; the kind carries the values (root ADR-0193 §5, §9: floor_kind and floor_number, not the floor label)
a count beside a list cut to a page is an old API's page shape; the kind carries the whole list and its length is the count
cutting a list to a page is the reader's choice, not a Gold's
values joined with a separator are display text; the kind carries the list
which data a screen reads first, and how fast it paints, is the web's (gongzzang) decision and target, not the platform's
a kind line names a host, a kind, a section and its columns; a panel or screen is the web's

scopes.gold_columns: every column of a gold.* table in infra/lakehouse/contracts/industrial_complex_lakehouse_contracts.json
scopes.kind_line_columns: the columns of every config/r2-connections.contract.json by_pnu_lanes line that names a host
scopes.kind_line_fields: the keys and string values of those lines (decision paths and reasons excepted)
scopes.gold_producer_names: quoted lower-case names in the Gold producers below
scopes.gold_producer_source: the source text of the Gold producers below
scopes.platform_contracts: config/*.json and contracts/data/*.yaml of foundation-platform, this file excepted
scopes.adr_target_rows: table rows (lines that start with '|') of docs/adr/*.md and platforms/foundation-platform/docs/adr/*.md
